Instructions for Use
Device description: The Boreal Fixation System is a orthopedic screw system. It is available in lengths from 8 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
MR Conditional (1.5T only): spatial field gradient ≤ 10 T/m; whole body SAR not to exceed 1.5 W/kg; There are no Transmit Coil restrictions.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
